data.change_summary: Implemented both pending amendments on the current branch. I restored the TAN/NO2 reproduction full-suppression defaults to preserve the legacy `excess / (threshold * 2.0)` curve shape by changing the runtime defaults and shipped `neocaridina_davidi` preset to TAN `3.0` and NO2 `1.5`, and documented that choice in the shrimp parameter docs/data. I also made molt-failure `PoorCondition` diagnostics consistent with the existing blended-condition semantics by tracking the minimum blended condition factor plus its paired raw condition/reserve factor and reporting that blended factor instead of emitting impossible raw-condition comparisons. Regression coverage now locks both contracts down with a new legacy-span test and a reserve-driven poor-condition diagnostic test.

steps.description: Inspected the current reproduction-suppression defaults and molt-failure diagnostic path, then chose to preserve the legacy TAN/NO2 suppression curve shape explicitly rather than widening test expectations around the steeper defaults.

Patched `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, the shipped shrimp preset, and the molt failure diagnostics path so reproduction defaults use the legacy full-suppression spans and `PoorCondition` events report the blended condition factor with raw/reserve context.

Extended regression coverage for the restored toxic-suppression spans and reserve-driven poor-condition reporting, then reran focused and broad validation across core, data, scenarios, and harness surfaces.
